west...@vp3643.pms.ford.com (William S. Westermann) writes:

>Hi All,

>Question : Can you give an ally a retainer ?
> (i.e., can I give my Renegade Garou a Ghoul Escort/Retainer
> or Tasha Morgan for a bleed ?)

Any minion can recruit an ally, so long as they have the appropriate
disciplines/status/whatever.

>Also,... I know this has been asked, but can't remember the ruling.
>Does Superior Eagle's Sight automatically intercept an action or
>does it merely let you intercept someone other than you predator/prey ?
>(i.e. I play E.S. to intercept an equiping action not of my predator/prey.
>Do I have to still play a +1 intercept or is it automatically blocked.)

(It will also allow you to block (D) actions not directed at yourself).
It simply overcomes the restriction on whose actions you can attempt to
block. You still must have the appropriate intercept to block
successfully.

L. Scott
